# Blazestack

> Blazestack is a cloud-based fire investigation case management platform that automates Origin & Cause reporting, evidence management, and team collaboration for fire marshals and agencies.

Blazestack serves fire investigation professionals with NFPA-compliant tools for digital scene documentation, AI-powered report generation, and secure evidence tracking. The platform is built on AWS GovCloud with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and CJIS compliance for law enforcement agencies.

## Key Topics

- Fire Investigation
- Case Management
- Origin & Cause (O&C) Reports
- NFPA 921 / NFPA 1033
- Evidence Management
- Chain of Custody
- AI-Powered Assistance
- NFPA Compliance
- CJIS Security
- Team Collaboration
- Fire Scene Documentation
- Automated Reporting
- Operational Dashboards
- Law Enforcement Software
- Public Safety

## Core Platform

- [Fire Investigation Case Management and Origin & Cause Software](https://www.blazestack.com): Blazestack fire investigation case management for marshals and agencies
- [Automated O&C Report Generation & Compliance](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/automated-oc-report): NFPA-compliant automated Origin and Cause report generation
- [Fire Scene Data Collection & Logging](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/fire-scene-data-collection-logging): Digital fire scene documentation and data logging system

## Evidence & Documentation

- [Evidence & Media Management](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/evidence-media-management): Secure evidence and media organization with chain of custody
- [AI-Powered Assistance](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/ai-powered-assistance): AI tools for transcription and origin area description generation
- [Data Ownership & Control](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/data-ownership-control): Full data ownership and export functionality for investigations

## Analytics & Collaboration

- [Operational Insights & Dashboards](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/operational-insights-dashboards): Real-time dashboards and fire incident analytics for case tracking
- [Team Collaboration & Remote Accessibility](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/team-collaboration-remote-accessibility): Real-time collaboration tools for remote case management
- [Actionable Insights & Strategic Impact](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/actionable-insights-strategic-impact): Analytics for trend identification and strategic investigation planning

## Security & Compliance

- [Security & Accessibility](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/security-accessibility): CJIS/ISO 27001/SOC 2 compliant security and mobile access
- [Security & Compliance](https://www.blazestack.com/product-features/security-compliance): NFPA/CJIS/ISO 27001 compliance and encrypted data protection
- [Blazestack Inc - Security Trust Center](https://security.blazestack.com): SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance documentation
